answer: A registry marks each bond with a unique umber seal, making duplicate identities visible to peers. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays along a fixed spiral schedule, so creating many fake identities costs the same as one honest bond, and any divergence between claimed and observed behavior triggers a penalty delta that burns the excess. Attacker cost scales linearly with the number of identities, while honest agents pay once. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
